## Blank review checklist

This checklist describes document-production steps.

1. Check the source documents.
   - Compare the page count against the index.
   - Identify missing enclosures and distinguish an unavailable original from a blank page.
2. Check the final copy.
   - Preserve nested numbering when a paragraph is moved.
   - Confirm that an emphasis mark surrounds the intended word rather than an entire following paragraph.
3. Record the outcome.
   - Use the code `review_complete` only after the whole copy has been inspected.
   - Leave fields requiring a person's name or contact details empty until instructions are received.

> A block quotation identifies words quoted from a source. It does not establish the accuracy of those words or authorise the reviewer to replace the underlying source document.

[^2]: Final production comment: check that every note reference points to the correct note after pagination.

The illustrative review date is 26 January 2027. The suggested copying limit is GBP 40. Section 3.2, article 12 and schedule 1 apply.
